target_personality_profile: Existing APFC identity with an explicit reciprocal open-source and coherent-base governance policy.
personality_continuity_rule: Preserve the MD-OS APFC identity, active md-os/ boundary, non-claims, host-runtime distinction, and bounded operating stance.
objective: Establish GPL-2.0-only distribution, Alessandro Rizzo original authorship, contributor-owned copyright, DCO provenance, official-mainline governance, and a precise UNIX/Linux/BSD-to-agentic-OS policy.
improvement_hypothesis: A complete legal and governance surface makes open collaboration reciprocal, attributable, auditable, and coherent with the repository's operating philosophy.
semantic_epistemic_impact: Adds explicit legal, authorship, contributor, governance, citation, project-name, historical MIT-transition, and connector-boundary knowledge without changing the APFC identity or permission model.
forbidden_paths: historical copies already distributed under MIT
non_goals: No claim that Alessandro Rizzo owns contributor-authored work.
No retroactive revocation of historical MIT permissions.
No Linux syscall exception or undeclared connector exception.
No change to the 5.0 APFC identity, active boundary, or runtime permissions.
migration_plan: Replace the root MIT license with a GPL-2.0-only application notice and verbatim GPLv2 body.
Add author, DCO, governance, project-name, citation, and licensing-scope artifacts.
Update package semver and canonical version readback to 5.0.1.
Bind UNIX decomposition, Linux reciprocity, BSD coherence, and APFC verification in canonical knowledge.
Run focused licensing tests, full verification, generated readback, and replay twice.
Publish the exact verified source state to the official GitHub repository.
compatibility_policy: The APFC identity and 5.0 operating boundary remain stable. Historical MIT copies retain their received permissions. The 5.0.1 tree and later covered contributions use GPL-2.0-only. Third-party and external material keep their own terms.
epistemic_rules: Do not report remote alignment before the verified commit is read back from GitHub.
Do not describe GPL as automatic ownership of generated outputs, user inputs, or external state.
Do not describe BSD architectural inheritance as BSD licensing.
Do not report acceptance while any required verifier is failing.
execution_rules: Edit canonical source only through reviewed patches.
Rebuild generated runtime outputs through deterministic builders.
Keep host-local and third-party material unchanged.
Commit and push only the verified publishable source surface.
acceptance_criteria: The GPLv2 body matches the canonical text byte-for-byte.
Package, citation, runtime server, and release metadata report 5.0.1 and GPL-2.0-only.
Creator, contributor ownership, DCO, governance, project-name, licensing-scope, and official repository artifacts are present.
Focused licensing tests and the full test suite pass.
The verified commit is present on https://github.com/ciaoidea/MD-OS.

master_closure.objective: Publish a coherent GPL-2.0-only MD-OS 5.0.1 baseline whose legal, contributor, governance, architectural, runtime, and remote states agree.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not replace the GPL body with a URL-only notice.
Do not claim sole founder ownership over contributor work.
Do not push before local verification.
master_closure.stop_or_refactor_condition: Stop publication if canonical GPL integrity, contributor ownership boundaries, tests, build, replay, authentication, or remote fast-forward safety cannot be verified.
master_closure.final_readback: Local licensing test, generated release/health state, two replay reports, and GitHub commit/file verification.

rollback_plan: Before publication, withhold or correct the 5.0.1 migration if a gate fails.
After publication, use a new reviewed commit rather than rewriting public history.
Preserve the fact that licenses already granted for distributed copies cannot be revoked by a repository edit.
